blocks.text:
Product Description               Turn any warm day into a bloom-filled splash party with the Melissa & Doug Sunny Patch Pretty Petals Flower Sprinkler! This delightful outdoor water toy features 12 whimsical flower petals that spin and spray water in all directions, creating a fun, refreshing way for kids to stay active outside. Just attach it to a standard garden hose and watch as the bright pink flowers come to life, sprinkling gentle streams of water that encourage kids to run, jump, and play. Built from durable materials designed for outdoor use, this sprinkler withstands hours of backyard fun while helping develop coordination, motor skills, and confidence through movement. Parents will love the easy setup and mess-free cleanup, while kids will love the giggles, splashes, and imaginative play during warm-weather playdates, parties, or family weekends. Combine this with the Melissa and Doug K’s Kids Bowling Friends Set, to create amazing outdoor adventures for the whole family. For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence!                  Brand Story               By Melissa & Doug
                    From the Manufacturer               From classic wooden toys to crafts, pretend play, and games, Melissa & Doug products provide a launch pad to ignite imagination and a sense of wonder in all children so they can discover themselves, their passions, and their purpose.

Since the company’s founding more than 25 years ago, Melissa & Doug has consistently delivered innovative products that inspire open-ended thinking, encourage kids to see new possibilities, and offer Countless Ways to Play. It’s part of a bigger vision to Take Back Childhood. Because by giving children a true childhood with the space and freedom to explore their world, we give them a path to realizing their full potential!             See more
